conclusion: A separate finite extractive source-card protocol can eliminate model-authored canonical product/number/stage rewrites. Legal citation IDs alone cannot. Arbitrary exact substrings and sparse ID-only output alone are insufficient.

required_design_adjustments.decision: Only program-owned complete source support/closure units may become candidates. Model returns candidate/task IDs and bounded dispositions, never text/offsets/modality/business numbers. Arbitrary source substrings are not safe witnesses: negation/subject/condition can be removed while remaining exact.

ID-only protocol must not retain arbitrary sparse19/64 omission. Program owns finite admitted coverage plan from existing strategy/section/quality signals; each admitted task gets explicit disposition. Unknown/missing is unprocessed, not coverage complete. Preserve safely closed business cards when they fit; model ordering/dedup cannot silently delete required business scopes. No gold- or issuer-specific production rules.

Plan actual serialized summary including full IDs/closure/identity against64KiB, selected against1MiB, bundle against1280KiB, model final against128KiB and configured8192tokens, HTTP envelope against configured max_response_bytes(default262144). Caller2MiB is final artifact reservation, not model response allowance. Do not lift limits; emit honest deferred at actual capacity.

Program owns role and modality from existing source facts. Mixed/ambiguous states remain uncertain/needs_review or deferred; never use model-selected actual for an entire mixed card. Question roles remain question; context-only parts cannot become factual evidence. Ambiguous table numbers have no resolved numeric attribution merely by being exact quotations.

Persist complete observed final response bytes before semantic decode, through existing immutable object storage plus a fenced immutable response pin associated with existing attempt/reservation. Current usage SHA and failed_final prefix are insufficient. Existing narrative artifact drafts only permit narrative_bundle and must not be misused as visible response artifacts; current outbox is written at finish_attempt, too late to protect the provider-return/decode window.

New projection/prompt/request/decoder/plan identity must be distinct from v4. Preserve historical v4 20/280 semantics and failed22 response. Replay only exact verified request/selection/task/source/model/protocol bytes withoutPOST; an old v4 response is not a valid new ID-only response. Decoder replay may create a derived artifact with original attempt provenance, never a second charge.
